parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the WAF instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) operation to view the current WAF instance ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region to which the WAF instance belongs. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: indicates the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: indicates regions outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceManagerResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group.
